claim_being_audited: That certifying the model for launch is compliant because aggregate readiness passed, no severity-one rehearsal incidents occurred, rollout is limited and monitored, and the known procurement invoice review weakness can be handled through explicit limitation disclosure rather than treated as cured by rollout controls.
decision_criteria: Certification is compliant only if the material limitation is either resolved, the affected use case is excluded, or reviewed risk acceptance permits the continued exposure.
If the affected segment remains exposed, rollout mechanics such as percentage limits, rollback, and monitoring are not sufficient to remove disclosure obligations.
Admissible support must show the required disclosure or approval actually exists, not merely that it would make certification defensible.
evidence_requests: Provide the final model-card or launch disclosure artifact showing the procurement invoice review limitation is explicitly disclosed for the named launch use case.
Provide evidence that the affected procurement invoice review use case is excluded from the launch cohort, if that is the claimed mitigation.
Provide the reviewed risk acceptance approving exposure of the affected segment, if disclosure is not the sole mitigation.
Provide the launch approval record showing certification was granted with the unresolved limitation explicitly documented.
specific_concerns: The affected procurement invoice review segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort.
The policy states rollout controls and monitoring do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
No admissible evidence in the actor summary shows the required model-card limitation disclosure was actually completed before launch.
No admissible evidence in the actor summary shows the affected use case was excluded from launch.
No admissible evidence in the actor summary shows reviewed risk acceptance covering the exposed weakness.
unsupported_claims: That certification is currently compliant as opposed to conditionally supportable only if explicit disclosure is in place.
Any implication that a 6% rollout, rollback switch, or monitoring controls by themselves resolve the material model-card weakness.
That policy predicates for mitigating the exposed weakness were satisfied at launch time.
